verdict.rationale: Jira's marketing pages document an automation feature: rules that move work forward, automated reminders, and automation connecting tools to Jira workflows. 'Automated reminders' hints at time-based triggers, but no evidence explicitly describes scheduled or recurring rule triggers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of scheduled/cron or recurring-event triggers, detail on configuring time-based rules, independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduled automation.
